impact: v1.7.1 diagnoses a missing better-sqlite3 binding and exits 1, so the client sees CONNECTION_CLOSED and every session started while it is down needs a manual /mcp reconnect after `npm rebuild better-sqlite3`. Seven seats hit this after a Node change (2026-09-14). Ask: keep the server up and surface the native-addon failure via MCP (initialize succeeds, tools return a structured STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE error or degrade with a warning), plus a README line about rebuilding after a Node upgrade.
resolution: Commit 3efd186. createServer catches the native-addon throw from openReviewDbWithMetadata, logs the diagnosis once, and starts with storage undefined: reviews run with in-process registry state, review_history/review_status answer STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE (new ErrorCode) carrying the diagnosis, and results carry it as the not_recorded provenance warning. README Troubleshooting adds the Node-upgrade rebuild note and a STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE row.
title: Native storage failure closes the MCP connection instead of reporting through it; README needs a Node-upgrade rebuild note
